topic: Supermarket roleplay: where can I find the eggs?

script.title: What to say at the supermarket

lines.text: Looking for something? I can help.
Yes, please. Where can I find the eggs?
They're in aisle five, next to the milk.
Kit's tip: excuse me, where can I find… works in any store.
